name: immersion-plan
description:
Creates language immersion plans with media, input, and output activities organized by proficiency level for language learners. Produces a structured immersion program the learner can follow without traveling.
Use when a learner asks to immerse themselves in a language, create a home immersion plan, find ways to practice daily, or increase language exposure.
Do NOT use for vocabulary study (use `vocabulary-building`), for grammar instruction (use `grammar-practice`), or for language level assessment (use `language-level-assessment`).
